name: Rani VIII
source:
An Egyptian girl who is participating in the Holy Grail War. She is intelligent and polite, and her servant is [url=/c3548]Berserker[/url].

[spoiler]She is actually a homunculus, created solely to take part in the war by her professor, Sialim Eltnam.

In Fate/Extra CCC, she serves as a member of the student council.[/spoiler]
